description:
Proposed procurement for NSN 5330015900498 PACKING ASSEMBLY:
Line 0001 Qty 18     UI EA  Deliver To:  By: 0045 DAYS ADO
This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The term of the contract/order will be one year or until the aggregate total of orders placed against the contract/order reach 350000.00. The estimated number of orders per year is 1. The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 2. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots.
Approved sources are 07270 36987-336; 5F573 7336FR-731-5717.
The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice.  Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available.
All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered.
Quotes must be submitted electronically.
